Excursions and day trips

Home · Excursions and day trips

These sit beside a longer safari or a beach stay. A day in Amboseli, Ol Pejeta or Tsavo from Nairobi is mostly driving, and the notes on those pages say so. Cultural days in Nairobi and Mombasa, Wasini, Watamu, the coast chama stay and the student beach package are here as well.

Kenya

1 day | Nairobi City Tour Half Day Tour

This half-day Nairobi City Tour offers a perfect blend of wildlife encounters, cultural heritage, local craftsmanship, and a world-famous dining experience. Ideal for visitors with limited time, the tour takes you through Nairobi’s most iconic attractions in a seamless and enriching experience.

1 dayView details
Kenya

1 day | Mombasa City Tour Half Day

Discover the rich history, culture, and vibrant lifestyle of Kenya’s coastal city on this immersive half-day Mombasa city tour. From iconic landmarks and historical monuments to bustling markets and Swahili cuisine, this tour offers the perfect introduction to Mombasa’s heritage.

1 dayView details
Kenya

1 day | Wasini Dolphin Tour

Experience a magical day at the Kenyan coast with our Full Day Wasini Dolphin Tour. This unforgettable excursion takes you to the pristine waters of the Kisite–Mpunguti Marine Park, home to playful dolphins, colorful coral reefs, and vibrant marine life. The tour also includes a cultural visit to Wasini Island and a delicious Swahili seafood lunch.

1 dayView details
Kenya

1 day | Watamu Safari Blue

Watamu is a beautiful coastal town along Kenya’s North Coast, renowned for its pristine white sandy beaches, turquoise waters, coral reefs, and rich marine life. This full-day excursion offers the perfect mix of nature, marine adventure, culture, and relaxation, making it ideal for couples, families, and groups.

1 day | Nairobi National Park Half Day Tour

Experience a thrilling wildlife safari just minutes from the city on this half-day tour to , the park offers an exceptional opportunity to see wild animals roaming freely against the backdrop of Nairobi’s skyline. Ideal for short stays, layovers, or business travelers, this tour delivers an authentic safari experience in just a few hours
